name: Aristech Plastics
blurb: Plastic pellets arrive by covered hopper and process chemicals by tank car; plastic resins leave by boxcar. The prototype island plant made plasticizers for flexible PVC. On HART, the yellow block, served by NVL.

name: A. Stucki Co.
blurb: Railway springs, machined parts, and steel for the island's railroad supplier. On HART, a green destination.

name: Calgon Carbon
blurb: Activated carbon, coal, and process chemicals. On HART, the purple block — a busy spot for NVL.

name: Ferrellgas
blurb: LPG arrives by tank car at the unload racks, and the empty tanks go back out. On HART, the red destination on the crew sheets.

name: Kosmos Cement
blurb: Cement and aggregate. On HART, the pink block — covered hoppers and bulk moves.

name: Shenango Coke Works
blurb: Coke for steel customers. On HART, the black destination — CK1 works the pickup, the weigh, and the reload when hoppers fail the scale.
